user.title: Scheduling Manager
user.description: Create a shared, local schedule manager. Existing 1.x schedules are migrated when you confirm setup. Configure schedules using the companion dashboard card.

abort.multiple_legacy_entries: More than one 1.x manager exists. Resolve the duplicate entries before migrating.

get_disabled.name: Get disabled state
get_disabled.description: Read schedule, sub-schedule or time-band disabled booleans. Leave path blank to discover descriptive and immutable UUID paths.

set_disabled.name: Set disabled state
set_disabled.description: Disable or enable a schedule, sub-schedule or time band using its descriptive or immutable UUID path.

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.description: True disables permanently. False cancels any timed disable and enables the control.

unsupported_version.message: Scheduling Manager requires Home Assistant 2026.7 or later.

invalid_storage.message: The saved schedule data cannot be loaded: {error}. The original storage file has been preserved. See the Scheduling Manager repair issue.

storage_unavailable.message: Scheduling Manager storage is temporarily unavailable. Check disk space and file permissions, then retry.

invalid_action.message: The Scheduling Manager action could not be completed: {error}.

migration_restart.title: Restart to finish the Scheduling Manager migration
migration_restart.description: Your schedules are running under Scheduling Manager. Restart Home Assistant once more to commit the transferred entity/device registries and safely retire the stopped 1.x entry and its old schedule Store. Do not delete either integration or its saved data manually. This notice clears automatically after the verification restart.

invalid_storage.title: Scheduling Manager cannot load its saved schedules
invalid_storage.description: The schedule storage is invalid or uses an unsupported format: {error}. The original `.storage/scheduling_manager` file has not been replaced. Restore a known-good Home Assistant backup, then reload the integration. Do not delete the original file to clear this issue; doing so would discard saved schedules. This issue clears after successful setup.
